question: NITI Aayog released the inaugural Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2025. Which state topped the index with the highest overall score, indicating strong fiscal management?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• NITI Aayog released the inaugural Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2025 to assess the fiscal management and health of Indian states.
 
• **Odisha** secured the top position on the Fiscal Health Index with the highest overall score, reflecting its strong fiscal discipline and management.
 
• The index evaluates states based on parameters like revenue generation, expenditure management, debt sustainability, and fiscal prudence.
 
• Odisha’s performance can be attributed to its effective debt management, high revenue mobilization, and prudent financial planning.
 
• It highlights the state's ability to maintain fiscal sustainability while meeting developmental and welfare objectives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fiscal Health Index (FHI):**

 
 
• The FHI is developed to measure the fiscal performance and sustainability of states, promoting transparency and accountability in governance.
 
• It includes parameters like fiscal deficit, debt-to-GDP ratio, revenue expenditure, and capital expenditure.
 
• The index aims to encourage states to adopt fiscal discipline and effective resource management.
 
 
 
• **Odisha’s Fiscal Reforms:**
 
 
• Odisha has implemented reforms such as digitizing revenue systems and reducing non-priority expenditures.
 
• The state has focused on increasing its tax base and optimizing public resource utilization.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog:**
 
 
• NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is a policy think tank of the Government of India established in 2015.
 
• It replaced the Planning Commission and focuses on fostering cooperative federalism by involving states in policy-making.
 
 
 
• **Debt Sustainability:**
 
 
• Debt sustainability refers to a state's ability to manage its debt obligations without compromising its developmental priorities.
 
• High debt-to-GDP ratios can impact fiscal health by increasing interest burdens and reducing funds for welfare programs.
